title: OmniSimulator: Aligning Small Language Models for Authentic Heterogeneous Behavior Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.29472v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential as general-purpose user simulators for interactive systems. Prior studies have demonstrated that training on high-quality data can substantially improve model reasoning and downstream task performance. However, the upper bound of user simulation is still constrained by the model's reasoning paradigm: native chain-of-thought often degenerates into shallow pattern matching and fails to adequately model the behavioral factors underlying real user decisions. In this paper, we propose OmniSimulator, a novel training framework designed to improve the predictive ability of small LLMs for realistic user simulation on short-video platform environments. translated_title: OmniSimulator：对齐小型语言模型以实现真实的异构行为建模
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）作为交互系统的通用用户模拟器已展现出巨大潜力。先前的研究表明，在高质量数据上进行训练能够显著提升模型的推理能力和下游任务表现。然而，用户模拟的上限仍受制于模型自身的推理范式：原生的思维链往往退化为浅层的模式匹配，无法充分建模真实用户决策背后的行为因素。在本文中，我们提出了 OmniSimulator，一种新颖的训练框架，旨在提升小型语言模型在短视频平台环境中进行真实用户模拟的预测能力。具体而言，OmniSimulator 通过一个包含五个维度的结构化模式来组织面向行为的推理，从真实用户行为场景中精选数据，并引入教师模型来生成高质量的推理轨迹。
tldr: 本文提出 OmniSimulator 训练框架，通过五维结构化行为推理模式、精选真实用户行为数据以及教师模型生成的高质量推理轨迹，对齐小型语言模型，从而显著提升其在短视频平台上进行真实异构用户行为模拟的预测能力。
en_tdlr: OmniSimulator is a novel training framework that aligns small language models for authentic user simulation on short-video platforms by organizing behavior-oriented reasoning through a five-dimensional structured schema, curating data from real user-behavior scenarios, and leveraging a teacher model to generate high-quality reasoning trajectories.
